usedFor: Kylas CRM holds the leads, and Razorpay collects the money, starting with “Create Invoice” for each new lead.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Created” in Kylas CRM, then “Create Invoice” in Razorpay
bestTemplate.why: A new lead can get an invoice with line items and an optional due date straight away.

watchOut: “Create or Update Lead” updates or skips when a phone or email already exists, so repeat buyers are not duplicated.
